title: The PowerPack Addons for Elementor: Widgets, Form Styler and Templates WordPress plugin before 3.1.3 does not validate…
description: The PowerPack Addons for Elementor WordPress plugin versions before 3.1.3 contains a vulnerability where it does not validate user-supplied URLs before making server-side HTTP requests. This flaw allows users with contributor role or higher to perform Server-Side Request Forgery (SSRF) attacks, potentially accessing internal or loopback network resources and reading the responses.
